Observability._comment_ServiceName: traceId/spanId/service/level/paymentId are the mandatory fields on every log entry (observability-standards.md); ServiceName is the 'service' field. Payment is one of the platform's 100%-trace-coverage services.

Otlp._comment_Endpoint: OpenTelemetry Collector OTLP/gRPC endpoint. Services never ship traces/logs to Tempo/Loki directly (observability-standards.md).

GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual ConnectionStrings:PaymentDatabase/Mongo:ConnectionString/Mongo:Database/Gateway:SigningSecrets values (kart-conventions.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in the gitignored appsettings.Local.json (see appsettings.Local.json.example); a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

ConnectionStrings._comment_PaymentDatabase: Write-side PostgreSQL - source of truth for PaymentIntent/Refund/IdempotencyRecord/GatewayWebhookEvent (database-design.md). Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or the ConnectionStrings__PaymentDatabase env var / K8s Secret in production, never committed.

Mongo._comment_ConnectionString: Read-side MongoDB (sharded in production) - the CQRS query side, per the user's explicit requirement (contracts/README.md deviation #1). Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or env vars / K8s Secret in production, never committed.

Gateway._comment_SigningSecrets: Per-gateway HMAC signing secrets for POST /v1/payments/webhooks/{gateway} (BRD §22). Secret - supplied via the GlobalConfig file locally, or a Kubernetes Secret in production, never committed.
